scope: Native macOS NGSolve task-thread performance on one fixed periodic MnZn bias/AC case. This is not a new physics accuracy, memory bound for all models, or universal solver scaling claim.
field_and_loss_agreement_tolerance: rtol=1e-8, atol=1e-10; all eight completed jobs pass their original equation and power gates
implementation: solver_threads.py activates SetNumThreads inside a real NGSolve TaskManager; --threads overrides PCB_MOTOR_SOLVER_THREADS. Runtime metadata is separate from physical resolution. The previous hard-coded SetNumThreads(1) was removed from the reduced solver.
origin_of_serial_default: Conservative memory/oversubscription/reproducibility setting carried over from the prior shared 4GB Linux host. Not a physics or macOS requirement. Legacy default remains reproducible; new local qualification runs explicitly use the measured 16-thread setting.
preserved_failed_trial: First benchmark invocation resolved the virtualenv interpreter symlink to the base Python and failed before loading NGSolve. V2 preserves the venv entry path, with a regression test. No failed performance trial was counted.

next_physics_trial.termination: Explicit early-settlement option, >=4 periods and unchanged 1e-5 last-two-period gate. This time is not an apples-to-apples speed comparison with the older fixed-eight-period timeout.
